judge_reasoning: Candidate 1 provides the most accurate, well-structured overview of the Irish independence movement with generally correct major events (1916 Rising, 1919–1921 war, 1921 treaty, civil war) and appropriate historical framing. Candidate 2 and 3 follow the broad outline but contain substantial factual errors—most notably Candidate 2’s incorrect “Treaty of Versailles” reference and its confused 1949/Commonwealth claim. Candidate 4 includes multiple major inaccuracies about key figures and institutions (e.g., Gaelic League founding and who became President), making it the weakest despite being on-topic overall.
